specializations.title: Agent specialization tags
specializations.description: Manage the closed vocabulary used to classify changes by technical specialization.
specializations.invalidFormat: Use kebab-case only (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

agentPoolTab.description: Overrides Configuration for this workspace only. Empty fields follow the Configuration defaults.

columnsTab.description: Agent, model and effort per role for this workspace. Fields you leave empty follow Configuration.

environment.description: Environment variables injected into agent processes launched for this workspace. They override those of Configuration.

verificationTab.description: Override of Configuration for this workspace only. "Inherited" follows Configuration; a change can still override the on/off steps. The browser driver (Chrome is reserved for a workspace) and the guidance are set here or in Configuration, never per change.
